scenario_text: An electronics giant has recently decided to venture into a related small-business area by developing wristwatch communicators. The device would be similar to a two-way radio and expected to work within a 50-mile radius. The company has considerable prior experience in product lines similar to this and believes that a lower price could pose a value-added challenge to the cellular market. I would like to have a working model to present at a national electronics fair in six months.

requirements.statement: The system shall enable two-way communication between wristwatch communicators within a 50-mile radius
requirements.business_justification: Competitive advantage in the market by offering a lower-priced alternative to cellular services
requirements.assumptions: Line of sight between wristwatch communicators and minimal interference from other devices
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Successful two-way communication between wristwatch communicators within the specified range

requirements.statement: The system shall have a user-friendly interface for easy operation and configuration
requirements.business_justification: Increased adoption and customer satisfaction by providing an intuitive user experience
requirements.assumptions: Users have basic knowledge of electronic devices and communication concepts
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Users can easily navigate and configure the device within 30 minutes

requirements.statement: The system shall be compatible with the national electronics fair's power and data requirements
requirements.business_justification: Successful demonstration of the product at the national electronics fair
requirements.assumptions: Fair organizers will provide necessary power and data infrastructure
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Device operates correctly and demonstrates features at the fair

requirements.statement: The system shall be developed and tested within six months to meet the national electronics fair deadline
requirements.business_justification: Successful product demonstration at the fair to generate interest and sales
requirements.assumptions: Sufficient resources and personnel will be allocated for development and testing
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Working prototype available for demonstration at the fair

issues.description: The term 'wristwatch communicators' is not defined. Is it a specific device model or a generic term?
issues.suggestion: Define 'wristwatch communicators' in the requirement or provide a reference to a published source that defines it.

issues.description: The term 'user-friendly' is vague and not measurable. What specific characteristics make the interface user-friendly?
issues.suggestion: Replace 'user-friendly' with specific, measurable criteria, such as 'users can navigate and configure the device within 30 minutes'.

sdlc.summary: The recommended model is Prototype, as it fits the project's needs for a working model quickly, requirements clarified by seeing them run, technical risk investigated before committing, and early feedback from real users. The project's fixed delivery window with approved scope implies stable requirements, making Waterfall less suitable. Agile is also less suitable due to the project's need for a working model at the national electronics fair.
sdlc.shortcut: Fixed delivery window + new product direction + working model at fair -> Prototype
sdlc.cross_check_reasoning: Agile fits because it allows for rapid development and testing, which aligns with the high priority and tight deadline of REQ-004. It also enables flexibility and adaptability, which is beneficial given the medium risk and medium priority of REQ-003.

controls.title: Security events monitored and alerted on
